summary: Whispers from Elysium Planitia” is an immersive, interactive web story that brings NASA’s InSight Mars lander back to life through a first-person narrative. Developed for the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge, the project translates dense NASA/JPL engineering archives and Martian seismic data into an engaging educational experience for school-age space enthusiasts. By combining interactive hardware guides, a before-and-after dust timeline, and a space exploration quiz, the project transforms historical space data into an emotional and accessible journey across the Red Planet.
details: An interactive web-based storytelling application where NASA’s InSight lander narrates its own mission—from its 2018 cleanroom assembly on Earth to its final dusty days in Elysium Planitia in 2022. Users can explore InSight's scientific instruments (like the SEIS seismometer that detected over 1,300 marsquakes), interact with a Before/After Dust slider, and test their knowledge with an integrated space quiz.
